custodianFinding: The Municipality of Rondonópolis, through its official SIGGEO / Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda references, is the local cadastral/map custodian evidenced here. IBGE map material was treated only as general national agency reference, not as the local parcel custodian.

layerReview.title: LOTES
layerReview.crs: WKID 102100 / EPSG:3857; response requested as EPSG:4326 GeoJSON
layerReview.nativeIdentity: id is the preferred native parcel identity; FID is the ArcGIS service object ID
layerReview.unsafeDataHandling: Owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, cadastral registration and other personal or unsafe attributes were not requested or retained. The layer schema was inspected only to identify safe fields and geometry.

queryOutcomes: Exact immutable WUP point query returned one polygon with FID 144582; this is a local hit only and is not a citywide coverage claim.
A bounded approximately 0.02-degree envelope around the point returned three polygon geometries with safe IDs in ignored scratch evidence.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
No parcel polygon was retained in the cohort directory; full raw responses remain only under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/ for auditability.
scopeLimits: The bounded queries do not establish complete municipal coverage, freshness, update cadence, legal title status, or parcel validity.
The WUP point is preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted to force a hit.
The public service's extensive schema includes unsafe fields; only the allowlisted identity and geometry are eligible for any future adapter work.
uncertainty: The native `id` field is documented by schema and public map configuration but its lifecycle/stability should be independently validated before adapter admission.
No serial reviewer qualification was performed; packet completion does not mean source integration/admission.
